name: Artie
description: Artie lets agents create, check, and manage the real-time database replication pipelines of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Artie account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which of my pipelines have errors or lag right now?
List the tables that the Postgres pipeline replicates to Snowflake.
Help me set up a pipeline from our MySQL database to BigQuery.

apps.name: Artie
apps.description: Pipeline setup, status, and management, over Artie's MCP server with browser sign-in.
